name: Camping Dreiländereck
beschreibung: Camping Dreiländereck is located in Ried im Oberinntal near the borders with Italy and Switzerland. The holiday park is situated on a sunny plateau with panoramic mountain views in the upper Inntal valley. It offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, as well as rental chalets and mobile homes. The border triangle area is a popular travel destination and a central hub for alpine tours. The surrounding region invites hiking adventures in the Stelvio National Park. Amenities include a restaurant, bread roll service, and modern sanitary facilities. In winter, the renowned ski areas of Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis are quickly reached.
